body: CHANGELOG updated in SKULDMARK: fix(format): v1 layout — swap SYMBOL/CIK field widths (SYMBOL 10->7, CIK 7->10). Founder: ticker padding was way more than needed while CIK didn't cover the SEC's own real 10-digit max. Fixed before any real identifier was ever issued under the v0 layout — a correction, not a migration. Total Length stays 25. go test + go vet clean. (sess-20260809-1420-e9d3d7f8)
